activation.note: Activation explicitly covers unchanged declared routes and exposed journeys, missing proofs, and invalid mandatory identities or bindings. Frontend substitution and excluded trees match the source; extra browser specs do not invalidate an otherwise qualifying Bun proof. Path/layer/task observations are distinguished from semantic finding and change observers that need implementation.

audit.summary: All 23 segments survive at their claimed destinations, with mandatory path and identity requirements retained in coder-facing text and the frontend substitution fully qualified. Shared nodes contain generic strictness and topology definitions; no undeclared additions, new waivers, or application-specific overfitting were found.

segmentChecks.note: The exact route and journey paths, declared-feature URN, and WMBT-declared Acceptance binding remain mandatory in then and are restated in evidence and verifier_detail.
The frontend-only Playwright substitution retains the Train/Journey binding alternatives, same-subject requirement, and E2E/SMOKE URN forms.
Browser identity by URN instead of Acceptance is explicit, and the journey-spec Acceptance prohibition is retained in avoid, evidence, and verifier_detail.
Strictness is preserved by shared:policy.strict-disposition and verifier_detail[6], while the package-rule statement remains verbatim in audit.
The topology_settings term is named and defined in shared:context.repo-topology.layers and retained in audit.
All four topology keys, their atdd-bun.yaml location, and all four defaults survive verbatim in the shared topology node and verifier_detail[0].
The one-behaviour/one-proof rationale and path-derived discovery requirement are retained in why, with the search-based alternative rejected in avoid.
The fix guidance to use the finding's exact path and the frontend Train/Journey alternative are preserved.
All four vendored/generated tree exclusions are retained in unless, verifier_detail, and activation.
Strict disposition is preserved in shared:policy.strict-disposition and explicitly restated as severity 3, disposition strict in verifier_detail[6].

risks: The coder-facing fields use <e2e_root> without explaining that it is resolved from topology in atdd-bun.yaml and defaults to e2e; that essential path-resolution detail is only in verifier_detail/shared context.
The Playwright URN patterns retain an unspecified … suffix, so a weak coder cannot derive a complete concrete URN from these fields alone; this ambiguity is inherited from the source.

unobservable: finding requires the declared new atdd_topology observer to expose plan declarations, journey surfaces, and test identity/binding semantics to Datalog.
change requires the declared new diff observer for declaration, path, URN, and binding edits; it is only an early trigger, not the scope of validation.

review.summary: All mandatory path, identity, frontend-substitution, exclusion, and shared strict/topology knowledge survives, so I agree with the auditor's PASS. The core coder decision is clear, though root resolution and concrete Playwright URN construction need outside context; activation is deterministic once its explicitly declared finding and change observers supply their facts.
